title: Ransomware blocks system recovery (T1490 Inhibit System Recovery)
note: Hand-written for the demo, not taken from the thesis data. The test sentences use different words from the training examples.
train: T1490: The ransomware ran vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet to remove every volume shadow copy.
T1490: Before encrypting files, the malware disabled Windows recovery with bcdedit /set recoveryenabled no.
T1490: The attackers deleted the backup catalog with wbadmin delete catalog so the victim could not restore the system.
T1490: The loader used WMI to delete all shadow copies on the host to block system recovery.
check: T1490: It wipes the volume shadow copies using vssadmin so that files cannot be restored.
T1490: The script turns off automatic repair through bcdedit before the payload runs.
T1490: Operators removed the Windows backup catalog using wbadmin to stop recovery.
T1490: The sample deletes each shadow copy through WMI so the system cannot be rolled back.
